description: Pixel art TV home shopping broadcast frame, 2000s CRT TV shot, 4:3. A haunted 24-hour shopping channel studio, always lit. LEFT: the show host, big, head to chest, facing the camera behind a glossy red podium with a chrome edge, both hands on the podium; black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, combed black hair, unnaturally white made-up face, huge pitch-black eyes, smooth salesman smile, lips closed. RIGHT: a waist-high demo table with a white cloth, its top bare and empty, in front of a dark plain wall area. BACK WALL: glossy red and black lacquer set panels with gold trim; upper right a sales board of red digits only; a prop shelf of product boxes at the far right edge. TOP: black lighting truss with spotlights and light beams, two cue light boxes with clap and smile icons. FLOOR: glossy black stage, confetti, yellow-black floor tape at the front. LIGHT: bright key light on the host's face and the table top, colored pink and cyan rim light, deep black shadows. Dense, highly detailed pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, no dithering, no blur, no letters, no other people.

reference_images.usage_description: LAYOUT ONLY: follow this line drawing exactly for where things are and how big: the host big on the left, head to chest, behind the podium; the demo table on the right with its top empty; the sales board top right; the light truss on top. Do not copy the plain white color or the thin lines.
PIXEL SCALE ONLY: these are product icons that will be placed on the demo table at this exact pixel size. Match their pixel density, outline thickness and shading. Do not draw these objects.

MATERIALS AND MOOD ONLY: copy the glossy red and black lacquer set panels, gold trim, black light truss with spotlights and the colorful stage lighting. Do not copy its layout, its small host, its letters or its objects.

HOST OUTFIT AND POSE ONLY: black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, standing behind a podium with hands on it. Draw him much bigger as in the layout, with an unnaturally white made-up face and huge pitch-black eyes. Do not copy the grey colors or the room.
